Earn points by guessing the sum of four cards. The highest final score wins.

Start with three cards each and four neutral cards in the middle of the board. Place one card edge to edge with a card on the board. A new code forms when four fragments meet in the center of a 2×2 square. If you complete no code, draw one card, even on your first turn.

Everyone privately guesses the sum for each new code. Aces count as 1, jacks as 11, queens as 12 and kings as 13. An exact guess earns 10 points. Miss by 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 to earn 5, 4, 3, 2 or 1 point respectively. A larger miss earns 0.

If a player empties their hand or the group reaches five codes, score every code from that placement. A player who empties their hand earns 5 extra points. Drawing the last card ends the game immediately at the current scores.

Tap Scan code and aim at the center where the four cards meet. Tap Lock code. Once locked, put the phone down, enter your guess (4–52) and tap Score. Only your guess and points are shown. Each set of four cards scores once per game on your scorecard.
